## Code {-}
Code for individual graphics can be accessed by clicking on the code button beside the graphic.  Occasionally there are pieces of data wrangling code that are separate from graphics.  These are also marked by a code button.  Code in the chapters of Part I, the case studies, often depends on code earlier in the same chapter.  Many of the graphics in Part II are versions of graphics from Part I and some of the initial code required can be found there.  As it says in Chapter 1: "There is no claim that the R code accompanying the book is to be recommended, but it may be helpful."

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_setupAll.R")

```
